name: slide-metadata-derived
body: Slide `number` must be the STRING position label derived from the slide's `(number, letter)` position: the number with the lower-cased letter appended for a vertical (letter) slide, and no letter for a horizontal slide; it must never be a flattened presentation index, the bare filename integer, or read from author frontmatter. Slide `total` must be the integer number of slide files in the deck, derived at render time.
